svg.title: Figure GK-2. Following distance and space cushion
svg.desc: Following-distance rule and space-management ideas from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) sections 2.5-2.7 (space ahead, behind, sides, overhead). Seconds are a handbook rule of thumb, not a substitute for actual stopping distance (Figure GK-1).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure GK-2. Following distance and space cushion

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Rule of thumb: at least 1 second of following distance for each 10 feet of vehicle length. Add 1 second if you are going over 40 mph.
